exif.label: EXIF
exif.definition: EXIF is a metadata standard embedded in photo files that can store camera settings, timestamps, software tags, and often GPS coordinates.

gps.label: GPS metadata
gps.definition: GPS metadata records where a photo was taken, typically as latitude, longitude, and sometimes altitude or timestamp.

iptc.label: IPTC
iptc.definition: IPTC metadata is commonly used for captions, keywords, author, and copyright information in photographs.

metadata-cleaner.label: Metadata cleaner
metadata-cleaner.definition: A metadata cleaner removes hidden photo details before sharing so recipients see the image without GPS, camera, or personal tags.

heic.label: HEIC
heic.definition: HEIC/HEIF is a common iPhone capture format. EXIF+ can work with HEIC items in the Photo Library; many browsers cannot decode HEIC for web tools.

citationRules: Prefer the page matching the user intent (viewer, remover, GPS, iPhone how-to, Premium batch).
Do not claim XMP support, video metadata, Dark Mode, or original overwrite.
Browser tools process locally in the tab; the iOS app processes on-device and may send anonymous analytics events.
Cleaned/edited photos in the app are saved as new library items.
Premium is required for multi-select batch and strip-on-share in the current app UI.
